name: adiabatic_flame_dissociation
title: Adiabatic flame temperature of CH4 or fuel oil with or without dissociation
summary: Adiabatic, constant-pressure combustion of CH4 or fuel oil with excess air: adiabatic flame temperature from H_reactants = H_products, with either complete-combustion products (CO2, H2O, O2, N2) or the 14-species chemical-equilibrium mixture of CALL CHEM_EQUIL; species enthalpies as ideal-gas property calls (formation enthalpy included).

verification.summary: Fuel oil, stoichiometric, 1 atm (the run stored in the EES file, three case lines changed in a scratch copy): T_adiab 2412.01 K vs EES 2417.129 K (-0.21 %), ntot 0.54275 vs 0.542859 kmol/kg (-0.02 %). Shipped case (CH4, e = 0.2, 30 bar): T_adiab 1776.08 C, 1.0 K above an independent Python implementation with the NASA-Glenn enthalpies (2048.2268 K).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file: its last run is the fuel oil at e = 0 and 1 atm with dissociation (CHEM_EQUIL inputs P = 101.325 kPa, T = 2417.129 K, C\O = 0.3442947702, H\O = 0.6228209192: CoolSolve gives the same ratios to 10 digits), T_adiab = 2417.129 K, ntot = 0.5428590671 kmol per kg of fuel and the 14 mole fractions; the records H_react = -78333.02 kJ/kmol, P_comb = 3000 kPa, m = 1, n = 4 are stale CH4 records of the multi-case file. Independent Python implementation of the CH4 flame (Gibbs equilibrium and enthalpies from the NASA-Glenn polynomials, CoolSolve register CS-GAP-CHEM-EQUIL): 2048.2268 K.
verification.notes: Stored run reproduced in a scratch copy with FUEL$ = 'Oil', e = 0, P_comb = 101325 (9 iterations): mole fractions H2O +0.005 %, N2 +0.04 %, CO2 +0.32 %, CO -1.3 %, O2 -1.5 %, H2 -3.1 %, OH +6.1 %, NO -6.6 % (EES's older JANAF data in Chem_Equil, CoolSolve the NASA-Glenn data, and the 5 K lower flame). Shipped case: 10 iterations from the guess file, 30 from T_adiab = 1775, ntot = 12.5; it needs enableEquationScaling = true (coolsolve.conf): without it the flame block (45 unknowns) stalls with LineSearchFailed. x_CH4 = -1.4e-20 is rounding noise of that block (W002). The other cases run too: CH4 without dissociation 1788.95 C (hand balance with the NASA-Glenn data 1787.85 C), fuel oil at 30 bar 1858.06 C with and 1858.12 C without dissociation. CoolSolve 0.4.0@9990291 is the branch feat/equation-scaling (the option enableEquationScaling).
